title: अष्टसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 78 · Nala's reign; Brihadashva teaches the dice

summary.en: Nala brings Damayanti home and rules in splendour. Brihadashva assures Yudhishthira that he too will regain his kingdom, that those who tell Nala's story will be free of misfortune, and teaches him the secret of the dice before departing.
summary.kn: ನಳನು ದಮಯಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಕರೆತಂದು ವೈಭವದಿಂದ ಆಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನೀನೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಮರಳಿ ಪಡೆಯುವೆ, ನಳಚರಿತ್ರೆ ಹೇಳುವವರಿಗೆ ದುರ್ದೈವ ತಟ್ಟದು ಎಂದು ಬೃಹದಶ್ವರು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡಿ, ಅಕ್ಷರಹಸ್ಯವನ್ನು ಉಪದೇಶಿಸಿ ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: नल दमयन्ती को घर लाकर वैभव से शासन करते हैं। बृहदश्व युधिष्ठिर को आश्वासन देते हैं कि वे भी अपना राज्य पुनः पाएँगे, कि नल-चरित सुनाने वालों को दुर्भाग्य नहीं छूता, और जाने से पहले उन्हें अक्षविद्या का रहस्य सिखाते हैं।
summary.te: నలుడు దమయంతిని ఇంటికి తీసుకువచ్చి వైభవంగా పాలిస్తాడు. నీవు కూడా రాజ్యాన్ని తిరిగి పొందుతావని, నలచరిత్ర చెప్పేవారికి దురదృష్టం అంటదని బృహదశ్వుడు యుధిష్ఠిరునికి భరోసా ఇచ్చి, అక్షరహస్యాన్ని ఉపదేశించి వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: நளன் தமயந்தியை வீட்டுக்கு அழைத்து வந்து சிறப்புடன் ஆள்கிறான். நீயும் அரசை மீண்டும் பெறுவாய், நள சரிதம் சொல்வோரைத் துரதிர்ஷ்டம் அணுகாது என்று ப்ருஹதஶ்வர் யுதிஷ்டிரருக்கு உறுதியளித்து, பகடை ரகசியத்தைக் கற்பித்துச் செல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: നളൻ ദമയന്തിയെ വീട്ടിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന് മഹത്വത്തോടെ ഭരിക്കുന്നു. ബൃഹദശ്വൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരന് ഉറപ്പു നൽകുന്നു: അവനും രാജ്യം തിരിച്ചുപിടിക്കും; നളന്റെ കഥ പറയുന്നവർക്ക് ദുർഭാഗ്യമുണ്ടാകില്ല. പോകുന്നതിനുമുമ്പ് അദ്ദേഹം ചൂതിന്റെ രഹസ്യം പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.78; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: बृहदश्व उवाच

meaning.en: Brihadashva said:

verses.text:
प्रशान्ते तु पुरे हृष्टे संप्रवृत्ते महोत्सवे ।
महत्या सेनया राजा दमयन्तीमुपानयत् ॥

meaning.en: When the city was calm and joyful and a great festival was under way, the king brought Damayanti back with a large army.

verses.text:
दमयन्तीमपि पिता सत्कृत्य परवीरहा ।
प्रस्थापयदमेयात्मा भीमो भीमपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Her father Bhima of boundless spirit and fearful prowess, slayer of enemy heroes, sent Damayanti off with honour.

verses.text:
आगतायां तु वैदर्भ्यां सपुत्रायां नलो नृपः ।
वर्तयामास मुदितो देवराडिव नन्दने ॥

meaning.en: When Vaidarbhi arrived with her children, King Nala lived happily, like the king of the gods in his garden Nandana.

verses.text:
तथा प्रकाशतां यातो जम्बूद्वीपेऽथ राजसु ।
पुनः स्वे चावसद्राज्ये प्रत्याहृत्य महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: Famed thus among the kings of Jambudvipa, the greatly renowned Nala lived again in his own recovered kingdom.

verses.text:
ईजे च विविधैर्यज्ञैर्विधिवत्स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः ।
तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र ससुहृद्वक्ष्यसेऽचिरात् ॥

meaning.en: He performed many sacrifices by the rules, with generous fees. Soon you too, king, will be restored with your friends.

verses.text:
दुःखमेतादृशं प्राप्तो नलः परपुरंजयः ।
देवनेन नरश्रेष्ठ सभार्यो भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Such was the sorrow that Nala, conqueror of enemy cities, suffered through gambling, he and his wife, O best of men, O Bharata.

verses.text:
एकाकिनैव सुमहन्नलेन पृथिवीपते ।
दुःखमासादितं घोरं प्राप्तश्चाभ्युदयः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Nala alone endured that terrible great sorrow, O lord of the earth, and then rose to prosperity again.

verses.text:
त्वं पुनर्भ्रातृसहितः कृष्णया चैव पाण्डव ।
रमसेऽस्मिन्महारण्ये धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: You, Pandava, are here in this great forest with your brothers and Krishna, thinking only of dharma.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणैश्च महाभागैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः ।
नित्यमन्वास्यसे राजंस्तत्र का परिदेवना ॥

meaning.en: You are always attended by great brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and Vedangas. So what is there to lament?

verses.text:
इतिहासमिमं चापि कलिनाशनमुच्यते ।
शक्यमाश्वासितुं श्रुत्वा त्वद्विधेन विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: This old tale is also said to destroy Kali's evil. A man like you can find comfort by hearing it, lord of the people.

verses.text:
अस्थिरत्वं च संचिन्त्य पुरुषार्थस्य नित्यदा ।
तस्याये च व्यये चैव समाश्वसिहि मा शुचः ॥

meaning.en: Reflect that human fortune is never steady, in its gains and its losses. Take comfort and do not grieve.

verses.text:
ये चेदं कथयिष्यन्ति नलस्य चरितं महत् ।
श्रोष्यन्ति चाप्यभीक्ष्णं वै नालक्ष्मीस्तान्भजिष्यति ।
अर्थास्तस्योपपत्स्यन्ते धन्यतां च गमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Those who tell, and those who often hear, this great story of Nala will not be touched by misfortune. Wealth will come to them and they will become fortunate.

verses.text:
इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा पुराणं शश्वदुत्तमम् ।
पुत्रान्पौत्रान्पशूंश्चैव वेत्स्यते नृषु चाग्र्यताम् ।
अरोगः प्रीतिमांश्चैव भविष्यति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this ancient, ever excellent tale, one will gain sons, grandsons and cattle and rank among the foremost of men. There is no doubt that he will be healthy and happy.

verses.text:
भयं पश्यसि यच्च त्वमाह्वयिष्यति मां पुनः ।
अक्षज्ञ इति तत्तेऽहं नाशयिष्यामि पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: You fear that someone will challenge you to dice again; I will remove that fear, O king, for I know the dice.

verses.text:
वेदाक्षहृदयं कृत्स्नमहं सत्यपराक्रम ।
उपपद्यस्व कौन्तेय प्रसन्नोऽहं ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: True-valiant son of Kunti, I know the whole secret of dice and of the Veda's lore. I am pleased, and I tell you: take it from me.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो हृष्टमना राजा बृहदश्वमुवाच ह ।
भगवन्नक्षहृदयं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Then the king, glad at heart, said to Brihadashva, "Blessed sir, I wish to learn the secret of the dice truly."

verses.text:
ततोऽक्षहृदयं प्रादात्पाण्डवाय महात्मने ।
दत्त्वा चाश्वशिरोऽगच्छदुपस्प्रष्टुं महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: Then Brihadashva gave the great-souled Pandava the secret of the dice, and after giving it, the great ascetic left to bathe at Ashvashiras.

verses.text:
बृहदश्वे गते पार्थमश्रौषीत्सव्यसाचिनम् ।
वर्तमानं तपस्युग्रे वायुभक्षं मनीषिणम् ॥

meaning.en: After Brihadashva had gone, Yudhishthira heard of Partha Savyasachi, the wise man, living on air and practising fierce austerity.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तपस्विभ्यः संपतद्भ्यस्ततस्ततः ।
तीर्थशैलवरेभ्यश्च समेतेभ्यो दृढव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: They heard it from brahmins and ascetics who kept coming from here and there, and from those gathered at the best holy places and mountains: that Arjuna of firm vows was practising hard austerity.

verses.text:
इति पार्थो महाबाहुर्दुरापं तप आस्थितः ।
न तथा दृष्टपूर्वोऽन्यः कश्चिदुग्रतपा इति ॥

meaning.en: So the mighty-armed Partha had undertaken a penance hard to attain, and no one else was ever seen with such fierce asceticism.

verses.text:
यथा धनंजयः पार्थस्तपस्वी नियतव्रतः ।
मुनिरेकचरः श्रीमान्धर्मो विग्रहवानिव ॥

meaning.en: Dhananjaya, Partha, the ascetic of strict vows, the solitary sage, glorious, was like dharma embodied.

verses.text:
तं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवो राजंस्तप्यमानं महावने ।
अन्वशोचत कौन्तेयः प्रियं वै भ्रातरं जयम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that he was tormenting himself with austerity in the great forest, O king, the Pandava, son of Kunti, grieved for his dear brother, the conqueror.

verses.text:
दह्यमानेन तु हृदा शरणार्थी महावने ।
ब्राह्मणान्विविधज्ञानान्पर्यपृच्छद्युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: With a burning heart, Yudhishthira, seeking help in that great forest, questioned brahmins of various kinds of knowledge.
